environment_tools_re_audit_turn_7.note: User-requested re-attempt of MCPs+plugins+skills. Found tools that are general-purpose and already enabled in this environment but intentionally kept separate from this repo's own tracked deliverables (no DRY conflict, nothing installed/adopted):

not_recommended.name: doc-coauthoring
not_recommended.reason: Anthropic example skill, not enabled; this repo's own CLAUDE.md already specifies authoring workflow/voice more precisely -- adding it risks conflicting guidance for no gain.

CLAUDE.md.purpose: Internal authoring constitution. Governs writing style (Rule Zero: plain words first, anti-slop) and engineering standards (WHATWG/W3C/MDN compliance, YAGNI/KISS/DRY, verify-before-done) for everything in this repo. Never referenced from published pages.

README.md.purpose: Public repo overview: what this is, how to use the site/skills/prompts exports.

CONTRIBUTING.md.purpose: How to add a principle page, skill, or prompt; points to scripts/verify-site.py as the pre-commit gate.

todo.md.purpose: Locked v1 deliverables checklist and completion checkpoint. Append-only.

changelog.md.purpose: Turn-by-turn history with the non-negotiable turncount. Append-only.

.yamllint.yml.purpose: Was: disables yamllint's truthy/line-length rules for Super-Linter's yamllint. REMOVED at turncount 2 along with Super-Linter (user instruction) -- had no other consumer.

.markdownlint.yml.purpose: Was: attempted to disable MD013 for Super-Linter's markdownlint; confirmed NOT honored (its bundled default of 400 won instead). REMOVED at turncount 2 along with Super-Linter (user instruction) -- had no other consumer.

.stylelintrc.json.purpose: Was: extends stylelint-config-standard, disabling 4 cosmetic rules for Super-Linter's stylelint. REMOVED at turncount 2 along with Super-Linter (user instruction) -- had no other consumer.

docs/.purpose: GitHub Pages site source (the Pages 'source' folder). Plain HTML/CSS, no build step, no JS.

index.html.purpose: Home page: card grid linking every principle page, in pedagogical order. Its outer <div class="wrap"> got a wrap-wide modifier class at turncount 10 so its card grid can use a wider shell than the site's default reading-column width.

about.html.purpose: How to read the site and use the /skills and /prompts exports.

404.html.purpose: Custom GitHub Pages error page (added turncount 12), placed at the Pages root per GitHub's exact requirement. Follows the site's own Empty & Error States principle (what happened / what to do next). Deliberately excluded from sitemap.xml.

sitemap.xml.purpose: sitemaps.org-protocol XML sitemap covering all 19 real pages (added turncount 12). datePublished-equivalent lastmod values pulled from real git history, not fabricated.

robots.txt.purpose: Allow-all robots.txt referencing sitemap.xml's full absolute URL (added turncount 12).

assets/style.css.purpose: Whole site's CSS: design tokens, responsive nav, good/bad example blocks, checklist styling, light/dark mode, print stylesheet, logical (RTL-safe) properties. Turncount 10: unified header/main/footer to one shared --content-width (was misaligned at 60rem vs 42rem), added a decoupled --prose-width for flowing text, a --content-width-wide/.wrap-wide shell for the home page's card grid, real depth (shadow tokens, hover lift) on cards, and custom-drawn checklist checkboxes + a details/summary chevron replacing bare default widgets.

assets/print-details.js.purpose: Forces every page's collapsed 'Go deeper' <details> open for the duration of printing (beforeprint/afterprint listeners), then reverts. Added turncount 9 because this Chromium build does not auto-expand <details> for print -- verified via an actual rendered PDF, not assumed.

.nojekyll.purpose: Skips GitHub's default Jekyll processing since the site is plain static HTML.

principles/*.html (17 files).purpose: One canonical page per concept, each following CLAUDE.md's 6-part skeleton (definition, why it matters, core rule, good/bad example, common mistakes, checklist). Turncount 12: every page's <head> gained a <link rel="canonical">, Open Graph + Twitter Card meta tags, and a JSON-LD TechArticle <script> block (headline/description/datePublished/author/publisher/mainEntityOfPage) -- no og:image, deliberately, since there's no image-generation pipeline.

skills/.purpose: Claude Code skills (SKILL.md format) turning principle checklists into agent-runnable procedures.

design-critique/SKILL.md.purpose: Reviews UI/HTML against all 17 principles' checklists; links back to every canonical page.

accessibility-audit/SKILL.md.purpose: Line-by-line code-scanning a11y audit with severity tiers; links back to the accessibility page.

plain-language-rewrite/SKILL.md.purpose: Operationalizes Rule Zero itself for arbitrary text; no single canonical page (it's the site's whole ethos, not one principle).

dark-pattern-audit/SKILL.md.purpose: Flow-by-flow dark-pattern audit (pre-checked opt-ins, confirmshaming, roach motel, fabricated urgency, drip pricing, forced continuity, misdirection); links back to the dark-patterns-ethics page.

empty-error-state-review/SKILL.md.purpose: Per-state review of empty/error screens against the three-part rule (what happened, why, what's next); links back to the empty-error-states page.

performance-audit/SKILL.md.purpose: Line-by-line scan for layout-level performance causes (unsized images, render-blocking fonts, eager-loaded/oversized media, above-the-fold contention); links back to the performance page. Added turncount 12.

responsive-design-audit/SKILL.md.purpose: Line-by-line scan for fixed-width layouts, guessed device breakpoints, and touch-target sizing; links back to the responsive-design page. Added turncount 12.

prompts/.purpose: Standalone system prompts (personas + judgment), for use outside Claude Code with any LLM.

web-design-mentor.md.purpose: Teaching persona for conversational design guidance.

design-critique-reviewer.md.purpose: Structured-feedback persona for reviewing UI, mirrors skills/design-critique's checklist.

ethical-ux-reviewer.md.purpose: Dark-pattern review persona, mirrors skills/dark-pattern-audit's test and pattern list.

ia-consultant.md.purpose: Navigation/IA planning persona, mirrors skills/design-critique's navigation-ia checklist plus card-sorting/tree-testing guidance.

performance-reviewer.md.purpose: Performance-review persona mirroring skills/performance-audit's checklist. Added turncount 12.

responsive-design-consultant.md.purpose: Responsive-layout consulting persona mirroring skills/responsive-design-audit's checklist. Added turncount 12.

scripts/verify-site.py.purpose: Stdlib-only checker: HTML tag balance, internal link resolution, CLAUDE.md skeleton-section presence, CSS brace balance. The repo's substitute for a test suite; also run in CI.

scripts/requirements.txt.purpose: Pins html5validator==0.4.2 (the only external Python dependency, used in CI for real W3C HTML validation). Exists specifically so actions/setup-python's pip cache has a lockfile to key off.

.github/workflows/pages.yml.purpose: Builds docs/ and deploys to GitHub Pages on every push to main touching docs/**. Independent of ci.yml so a flaky external link can never block a deploy. The deploy job intentionally has no `environment: github-pages` block (removed at turncount 3): that environment's branch-restriction rule only allows the repo's actual default branch, which is still the old feature branch, not main -- confirmed live-blocking via the real GitHub API error. Workaround, not root-cause fix; see codemap history and changelog.md turn 3.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.purpose: Two parallel jobs: verify-site (scripts/verify-site.py + W3C html5validator), link-check (lychee, external links only). Previously had a third super-linter job, removed at turncount 2 (see history) after 3 rounds of real failures -- verify-site + real html5validator/stylelint runs already covered correctness. Turncount 12: lychee's args gained --exclude for the site's own domain, since turncount 12 added absolute self-referencing URLs (canonical/og:url/JSON-LD) that a live external check can't reliably resolve mid-deploy -- confirmed with the real lychee binary before applying.

.github/dependabot.yml.purpose: Weekly PRs to keep every pinned GitHub Action version/SHA current.

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/.purpose: Two issue templates -- bug-or-content-fix.md, new-principle-suggestion.md (added turncount 12).

history.change: Initial codemap created capturing full repo state as of this turn (repo already contained the site, skills, prompts, and CI/CD from prior turns; this is the first turn codemap.json itself has existed).

Removed Super-Linter job from .github/workflows/ci.yml (explicit user instruction, after 3 rounds of real failures). Removed .stylelintrc.json, .markdownlint.yml, .yamllint.yml as a consequence -- they existed solely to configure Super-Linter's bundled tools and had no other consumer once it was gone.

Removed the environment: github-pages block from pages.yml's deploy job (real root cause found via a merged GitHub Copilot PR on the old feature branch: the environment's branch-restriction rule blocked main since the actual default branch is still the old feature branch). Confirmed via GitHub's own deployment API that the site is now live. Also corrected the record: the repo is public (confirmed via API), not private as claimed in conversation.

v2 scope executed: added 4 principle pages (iconography-imagery, navigation-ia, empty-error-states, dark-patterns-ethics), 2 skills (dark-pattern-audit, empty-error-state-review), 2 prompts (ethical-ux-reviewer, ia-consultant); extended design-critique's checklist to cover the 4 new pages; regenerated nav across all 16 HTML files and regrouped the home page into 4 category sections; added a vanilla-JS substring filter box to the home page; filed GitHub issue #2 documenting the still-unresolved default-branch/environment-protection admin blocker.

Confirmed v2's push (b89bfeb) green via the GitHub Actions API (CI run 30275201107, Pages run 30275201186, both success) -- v2 complete. Re-audited MCPs/plugins/skills per user request: Mem0 selection unchanged but status refined (connected, not enabled-in-chat, rather than a flat outage); noted an already-enabled 'design' plugin and two already-enabled personal skills (web-design-reviewer, frontend-design) as available general-purpose tools, kept separate from this repo's own deliverables.

v3 scope executed: added 3 principle pages (internationalization-localization, data-tables, onboarding-progressive-disclosure, bringing the total to 17); extended design-critique's checklist to cover them; regenerated nav across all 16 pre-existing HTML files and added the 3 new cards to the home page's category groups; converted every physical-direction CSS property in style.css to its logical equivalent for RTL-readiness; added a print stylesheet plus assets/print-details.js to force-expand <details> content during printing. Caught and fixed two real bugs mid-implementation via actual verification rather than assumption: (1) a regex backreference bug that silently corrupted all 17 principle pages' closing tags when inserting the print-details.js script tag, caught by re-running html5validator immediately after the change; (2) a wrong assumption that browsers auto-expand <details> for print, caught by testing with an actual rendered PDF rather than trusting CSS media emulation alone.

Design QA fix (user-reported, not part of a locked version): used the web-design-reviewer skill to actually screenshot the site at 4 viewports before touching anything. Found and fixed a real alignment bug (header used a 60rem container while main/footer used 42rem, independently centered, so nothing lined up), unified them to one shared --content-width, decoupled prose measure into its own --prose-width so reading lines didn't get worse, added a wider .wrap-wide shell for the home page's card grid, and replaced several bare/default-looking components (cards, checklist checkboxes, the Go-deeper details/summary, the mistakes list) with actual designed treatments. Re-verified with fresh screenshots (light + dark, 4 viewports) and a rendered-PDF print check rather than assuming the CSS diff alone was sufficient.

Confirmed both the v3 push (8020113: CI run 30291917438, Pages run 30291917990) and the turn-10 design-fix push (85a35c1: CI run 30292918436, Pages run 30292918359) green via the GitHub Actions API. v3 and the design QA fix are both now complete.

v4 scope executed, locked and tool-selected autonomously per explicit request (no AskUserQuestion round): added sitemap.xml, robots.txt, Open Graph/Twitter Card meta tags + JSON-LD TechArticle structured data across all pages, a custom 404.html, 2 new skills (performance-audit, responsive-design-audit) + 2 new prompts (performance-reviewer, responsive-design-consultant), and repo hygiene (issue templates, PR template, CODEOWNERS). Self-caught a real CI risk before it reached a real run: the new absolute self-referencing URLs would fail lychee's live external check (including 404.html's own URL, which can't resolve until the separate Pages deploy finishes) -- verified with the actual lychee binary and fixed via a domain exclude in ci.yml.

Confirmed the v4 push (23fa48d) green via the GitHub Actions API: CI run 30314389179 and Pages run 30314389159, both success. Went to job level specifically for the External link check/lychee job (the one the turn-12 fix targeted) rather than trusting the aggregate conclusion -- job log confirms Total 487, Excluded 20, Errors 0, matching the local test exactly. v4 is complete.
